corrected_fields.summary: U.S. Bancorp filed an 8-K current report disclosing the voting results from its 2026 annual shareholder meeting held on April 21, 2026. Shareholders elected all twelve director nominees, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, and ratified Ernst & Young LLP as the independent auditor. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
